title: Research: present-head flag 9 hosts basis head only after source drop (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

One-flag follow-up under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. [#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349) shows the basis head meets the target final on only 4 of 208 matched flags (present-head class `(0,1,9,43)`). [#3392](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3392) pins one of the other 204 (absent-head flag 2). This package pins one of those four: flag 9 (`X4` → `Y23`, basis head `196`).

On the published 4,058-event word:

- `X4` starts at `[196]` and drops `196` at transport event 500
- every annotated `Y23` frame before the terminal transport avoids `196`
- the head appears on `Y23` only in the after-frame of event 3489 (gap 2989)
- no event names both endpoints; neither frame is restored

The published channel therefore cannot chronologically dirty-restore that source line into the matched target along co-hosted basis-head geometry, even though the target final contains the head.

**Scoped obstruction. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. Coefficient delivery (flag-0 cascade) is outside this package.

## Result

Package: `research/p104-present-head-flag9-audit/`.
Tip: `acc2fa45374ce34c2d6293b862c3dcafb853ffa6`.
Content tip: `ae18b8db189f777bef159530d5395ebfe024f7b1`.
Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-present-head-flag9-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag9-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag9-audit/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag9-audit/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-present-head-flag9-audit
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG9 flag=9 head=196 preterminal_hosting=0 drop_event=500 arrive_event=3489 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG9_INDEPENDENT flag=9 head=196 preterminal_hosting=0 drop_event=500 arrive_event=3489 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG9_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-present-head-flag9-audit outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349) for the 4/208 present-head census; [#3392](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3392) for the complementary absent-head obstruction. Does not reopen that census, the flag-2 path, #3441/#3436/#3421/#3411, deferred V45/rho=0, or the merged readout series through #2883. Soft-overlap checked against open #3363/#3365/#3371/#3372 (coefficient delivery).
